_comment: The SML U-NAPTR answer for Hornnes Håndverkstjenester (0192:837056942) — the one-in-43 non-ELMA case (DECISIONS.md D-046(b), the hardcoded-host trap). tasks/T48-recon.md recorded only the resulting URL (smp.conta.no, no trailing slash), not the raw record fields, so this task made one fresh, keyless, live DNS call to record them: this session, 2026-09-09, dnspython 2.8.0 (dns.resolver.resolve, the system resolver via /etc/resolv.conf, lifetime=8s). `smp_base_url` is the substring between the second and third '!' of `regexp` — note it has NO trailing slash, unlike ELMA's, which is exactly the join trap C2 warns about.
